definitions.full: H2928. Telem טֶ֫לֶם proper name, of a location or person 1. location in the Negeb of Judah , Josh 15:24 = טלאים 1Sam 15:4 , read perhaps טֵלָאם We Dr. We reads טֵלָם also for חוילה 15:7 , compare Dr. 2. person one of the porters Ezra 10:24 .
